New York has some famous bridges; these engineering examples have helped set the tone for how bridges around the world are designed.
New York City might be known as the concrete jungle, but its nearly 30,000 acres of park space have been an ever-present part of this metropolis.
Keeping the lights on in New York City is no easy task; as New York moves towards a greener future, the manner of generating electricity will have to evolve.
Un hombre pobre decide solucionar sus problemas económicos al forzar a una de sus hijas a casarse con un hacendado.
Dos grandes amigos son muy mujeriegos, pero uno ama a la hermana del otro, pero por enredos de faldas la pierde.
Cuando un hombre pierde dinero en el juego, y olvida ir a su propia boda, su novia embarazada es enviada a Europa.
Un joven maestro llega a un colegio para señoritas para impartir la materia de música y escandaliza a la directora.
Una niña es adoptada por un regimiento militar y educada como varón, cuando ella se enamora creen que es un marica.
Una joven va con su novio a bailar y la abuela de ella sale a buscarla de noche en delegaciones, discotecas y cabarets.
Dos rancheros terminan su trabajo en la hacienda y van a la fiesta de un pueblo donde se gastan el dinero de su tío.
José José muestra la realidad de la vida de una estrella y cómo la fama, el dinero, y los placeres pueden destruirlo.

Desde pequeñas, Yolanda y su hermana gemela Irene sufren por el abandono de su padre. Al crecer, Yolanda se convierte en cantante y encuentra el amor, mientras que Irene sufre tragedias y decepciones. El destino las enfrenta con su padre de nuevo.
Durante una gira por los Estados Unidos, un cantante argentino se enamora de una artista mexicana que es casada.
Una famosa cantante de rancheras abandona su carrera, cuando muere su esposo, pero luego se arrepiente de su decisión.
Un hacendado muere de disgusto cuando su rival le hace creer que le ha quitado legalmente sus propiedades.
En una agradable amistad entre un hombre despreocupado y un muchachito, surge una extraña sorpresa.
Un grupo de jóvenes se pierde en el desierto al caer su avión, mientras que lejos de ahí su empresario los espera.
A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

Kristy Thomas and her six best friends struggle to make their successful business -- the Baby-Sitters Club -- into a full-fledged summer day camp. When a group of adults led by their crotchety neighbor, Emily Haberman, tries to shut down the camp, the girls must band together to keep their dream alive. Meanwhile, each club member faces her own personal challenges, including divorced parents, a discouraging diabetes diagnosis and an innocent crush on an older boy.

An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds.

Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz).

When a heist goes wrong, thief Miles hides a diamond at a construction site before he's arrested. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey.

A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies.

Broke and without work, newspaper reporter Eddie Willis (Humphrey Bogart) agrees to work for the corrupt boxing promoter Nick Benko (Rod Steiger) to help hype his new boxer, Toro Moreno (Mike Lane). While Toro is beastly in appearance, he has no actual boxing talent, and all his fights are fixed. When Toro gets a shot at the title against the brutal Buddy Brannen (Max Baer), Willis is faced with the tough decision of whether to tell Toro that his entire career is a sham.

Suburban couple Richard Harmon (Dick Van Dyke) and his wife, Barbara (Debbie Reynolds), have exhausted their patience in their marriage. Bored and no closer to fixing their problems through counseling, the couple opts to divorce, and the proceeding tug-of-war over children, money and possessions reveals that maintaining their marriage was far easier than ending it. Along the way are attempts for both at new relationships, with the subject of alimony playing a hidden role in matters.

After two years of failing to make it big in New York City, small-town model and actress Gladys Glover (Judy Holliday) takes a gamble by investing in billboard advertising to get her name out there. Almost immediately her risk pays off, and she finds herself inundated with media requests and fans, including the affections of the wealthy Evan Adams III (Peter Lawford) of the Adams Soap company. While Glover enjoys the spotlight, her boyfriend (Jack Lemmon) is less pleased about it.

A police officer seems to have committed suicide, but Detective Dave Bannion thinks there's more to the story. After talking to the man's mob-connected mistress, Bannion discovers far-reaching corruption that leads all the way from the police station to kingpin Mike Lagana. But when the policeman's lover is killed, it becomes clear that crossing Lagana is a dangerous thing to do. Soon Bannion finds himself marked for death and his family in mortal danger.

When Joanna Drayton (Katharine Houghton), a free-thinking white woman, and black doctor John Prentice (Sidney Poitier) become engaged, they travel to San Francisco to meet her parents. Matt Drayton (Spencer Tracy) and his wife Christina (Katharine Hepburn) are wealthy liberals who must confront the latent racism the coming marriage arouses. Also attending the Draytons' dinner are Prentice's parents (Roy E. Glenn Sr., Beah Richards), who vehemently disapprove of the relationship.

In this adaptation of Truman Capote's seminal true-crime novel, ex-convicts Perry Smith (Robert Blake) and Richard Dick Hickock (Scott Wilson) hatch a plan to rob a wealthy Kansas family, the Clutters. The men enter the Clutter home expecting to find a safe filled with cash, but in fact find no money at all. Enraged, they kill the entire family and flee. While on the run, they face not only the realities of their terrible crime but also their own earthly impermanence.

After years on the East Coast, former boxer Jack Mahoney returns to New Mexico and finds himself framed for murder. Though the only evidence is circumstantial, in the face of vicious prosecutor Kiefer, Mahoney's girlfriend—defense lawyer Gail Kingston—fails to convince the jury of his innocence. Determined to clear Mahoney's name, postal worker Steve Reynolds transforms himself into the masked rider known as the Durango Kid.

Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.

Hannah Brockway has a perfect fiancé in Dr. Sam Martin. Sam, who is respected by Hannah's family, is a noble man who cares for her and can make a good living in their frontier town. Yet Hannah craves adventure and finds it when she meets dashing Ben Dembrow, the youngest of a notorious crime family. Together Ben and Hannah set off to forge a new life, but prejudice and strangling family ties soon bring trouble to these newlyweds.
The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

In the 1870s, Marshal Wyatt Earp (Bruce Cowling) calls upon Dodge City, Kan., Sheriff Bat Masterson (George Montgomery) to track down rancher Merrick (John Maxwell), who is accused of murder. But, thanks to some proof held by local Native American Chief Yellow Hawk (Jay Silverheels), Masterson realizes Merrick might be the victim of a frame-up. So, with the help of Earp and gunfighter Doc Holliday (James Griffith), Masterson sets out to find those who are really behind the killing.
A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.
A cowboy finds himself in serious trouble with a notorious outlaw.

Un joven debe dinero de drogas y decide irse a vivir con sus tíos a otra ciudad para escapar, pero lo siguen para cobrarle todo el dinero que debe. El joven se roba la tarjeta de su tía y saca el dinero, pero el cobrador se lo quita todo.

Un joven se va de su casa porque su padrastro lo maltrataba, su abuela se pasa buscándolo, pero él no quiere regresar con su familia y conoce a una mujer que lo utiliza para robar al lado de otros niños de la calle.
Una joven comienza a beber porque en su casa tiene muchos problemas, un día la chica se droga y la llevan al hospital, pero ella sigue bebiendo. Sus padres la ayudan y deciden tomar terapia familiar.
Una joven graba vídeos maltratando a la gente para subirlos a la red. La mejor amiga de la joven se preocupa al saber que subir vídeos le ha traído algunos problemas en el colegio.

Una mujer que se hace pasar por trabajadora social se lleva a una niña a una casa hogar después de que sus padres fueran encarcelados por robar. La señora planea vender a la niña a una pareja que no puede tener hijos.

Refugio insiste en hacerle creer a Ángel que la vida de uno de sus seres queridos corre peligro, después de escuchar al tecolote cantar. Más tarde, El señor sufre un accidente automovilístico y trata de llegar a su casa.

Diana es una chica que se lastima a sí misma para llamar la atención y sentir un alivio ante los problemas que existen en su casa. Diana se enamora de Adrián, un nuevo compañero de la escuela, pero provoca los celos de Rebeca, su mejor amiga.

For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives.

Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board.

Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

When North Korean ruler Kim Jong-il (Trey Parker) orchestrates a global terrorist plot, it's up to the heavily armed marionettes of the highly specialized Team America unit to stop his dastardly scheme. The group, which includes the thespian-averse technology expert Chris (Matt Stone), not only has to face off against Jong-il, but they must also contend with F.A.G., the Film Actors Guild, a cadre of Hollywood liberals at odds with Team America's "policing the world" tactics.
A beautiful girl (Ximena Romo) complicates matters between an orphaned shepherd (Christian Vázquez) and his rival (Iván Arana).

A low-level Washington, D.C., public servant, Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), is thrust into the national spotlight when he's asked by Martin Geller (Dylan Baker), the head of the Democratic Party, to run for president after the party's presidential and vice-presidential nominees are killed in a plane crash. The odds are against Gilliam, mostly because he has a penchant for telling the truth about what is wrong with the country. Remarkably, his straight-talking style catches on with the public.

Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.

A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor.

Tony Pastrana decide proteger a Esperanza y hacerla su socia, para eliminar a Aurelio. Ella tiene miedo, pero Tony le asegura que vivirá. Mónica se entera de la relación de Rutila y Javier.
Javi y Aurelio sostienen una conversación que marca el destino de la familia. Ambos coinciden en que Rutila tiene un carácter difícil. Casillas teme que el pasado, les cobre la cuenta.
Mónica se niega a participar en el plan de Tony y Esperanza para acabar con Aurelio. Esperanza sospecha que Mónica podría delatar su plan porque aún ama a Casillas. Rescatan a Salazar.
Leandro cree que si Aurelio sigue siendo el problema, habrá que deshacerse de él. Raymond lo piensa. Esperanza, Tony y Mónica acuerdan competir en el mercado; llaman a Rafael a Colombia.
Esperanza, borracha, se siente culpable por la muerte de Zoe y triste, porque extraña a sus padres. Mónica la exhorta a que no se deprima y que no sea una víctima psicológica de Aurelio.
Todos coinciden en Tenerife. Aurelio, la Madame y Alí, la Marina de España, la DEA y la Interpol. Hay nervios, pero Casillas sabe cómo rescatar las 30 toneladas de droga incautadas.
Aurelio convence a Niñón de que financie la renta de los aviones necesarios en España, para así recuperar el cargamento incautado.
Tony y Mónica hacen negocios con Doble 30 y piensan dejar a Ninón fuera. También planean el secuestro de su hijo. Le dieron instrucciones a Alí para proceder con el ataque.
Ninón le pide a Aurelio que la ayude a encontrar a su hijo, secuestrado por orden de Tony Pastrana. Aurelio la apoya y le promete que lo van a encontrar con vida. El español juega sucio.
Omar disminuye los rumores de que El Señor de los Cielos está vivo. Paloma escapa de la casa presidencial. El primer mandatario le encarga a Casillas una macabra misión contra ella.
Ninón llega al sitio donde tienen secuestrado a su hijo y, momentáneamente, le arruina el operativo de rescate a Aurelio. Casillas le pide a Dalvio que le haga un favor al presidente.
En Marsella, Aurelio toma la iniciativa de atacar a Filemón y a los secuestradores de Leonardo. Alguien resulta herido. Colón y su equipo se enteran de que se están robando la droga decomisada.
Ismael, Raymundo, Chatarrero y sus secuaces recuperan toda la droga. La ubican en las naves robadas y la distribuyen. Dejan muchos muertos a su paso. Ninon revela su secreto a Casillas.
Mónica convence al presidente para que le conceda una audiencia a Pastrana. El español le propone a Terán una vida paradisíaca en el exilio, haciéndose doblemente millonario, pero con una condición.
Ismael lleva a Leonardo a casa de Rutila para esconderlo, pero no es bien recibido, ni por Rutila ni por Mónica. Les pide que lo ayuden a encontrar al Chema; Leonardo quiere conocerlo.

Don Ramón está preocupado porque El Chavo no come ni cena y en la noche se vuelve un sonámbulo y lleva platos a su barril. La Popis investiga el caso. Doña Florinda se une a la Asociación Protectora de Animales.
El señor Barriga lleva al Chavo y a Ñoño de vacaciones a Acapulco. La gente de la vecindad y el Chavo pasan una noche llena de buenos deseos y amor en las playas de Acapulco.
El Chavo imagina que es un gran corredor de autos; Don Ramón realiza una competencia entre los niños de la vecindad para jugar con sus nuevos autos de carreras.
El Chavo y Quico se divierten jugando a la lucha libre con unas máscaras. Don Ramón se va de la vecindad y se disfraza del Justiciero Enmascarado.
El Chavo y Ñoño ven una película de terror sin permiso, pero luego cualquier cosa les da miedo. Más tarde, Popis y el Chavo deciden espantar a Quico usando una sábana.
El Chavo amarra unos globos a la canasta de comida de doña Florinda y hace que flote. Ella piensa que don Ramón es responsable y lo persigue mientras el Chavo pincha los globos con su resortera.
Jessica y don Justo se pelean por tener a Plácido como empleado solo para poder humillarlo. Gaby comienza a tener náuseas y las mujeres de la casa creen que está embarazada de nuevo.

Gaby y Plutarco creen que Justito se va a poner celoso con la llegada del nuevo bebé. Plácido decide apostar en la quiniela del fútbol y descubre que tiene los números ganadores, pero Renata comete un error al poner la apuesta.
A Doña Lucha se le ocurre hacer un calendario sexy con todas sus vecinas, pero no se vende como ella esperaba. María se pone colágeno en los labios para conquistar a Albertano.

La familia P. Luche festeja el Día de las Madres de una manera muy particular. Ludovico intenta componer el baño, pero un plomero muy guapo lo ayudará.
Chico y Margarita son dos niños que viven en pobreza extrema y que, por ir a buscar comida, entran a escondidas a la casa de Maca y su hija Sofía, quienes los ayudarán a tener una vida mejor.

Ximena y Diego se gustan, pero él es un chavo que solo gusta de mucha diversión y nada de estudio. Es por ello que ella no quiere andar con él y Diego tiene que decidir entre ser responsable o seguir en el libertinaje.

Gisela no perdona a su padre Fidencio, pues este la abandonó desde que era pequeña. Sin embargo, ahora que regresó, ella no puede perdonarlo, y las circunstancias la obligan, por su hijo, a encontrar una vida llena de perdón.

Aurora le deja una carta a Juana donde le explica por qué ha decidido irse por un tiempo lejos de Mariano. Fernando le pide a Arturo que acepte su departamento y se vaya a vivir ahí con Teresa.

Orlando le dice a Chana que Soledad se robó a Ana Lucía. Evaristo le ofrece sus servicios de investigador privado a Santiago para saber su verdadera identidad. Ana Leticia planea exhumar el cuerpo de Marcelo para hacerle una prueba de ADN.
Chana le lee las cartas a Ramiro y le advierte que Ana Laura corre peligro y que Ana Lucía murió. La Policía detiene a Santiago y lo interrogan por la muerte de Gina.

Renata le pide ayuda al doctor Lemus para falsificar la prueba de paternidad y hacerle creer a Guillermo que es el padre del hijo que espera. Mónica y sus amigas ayudan a poner una hermosa ofrenda en la vecindad para recordar a sus muertos.
Guadalupe amenaza a Carmina para impedir que siga haciendo daño. Gael le confiesa a Elisa que estuvo con otra mujer. Damián le pide perdón a su mamá.

Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.

The board chairman of Drysdale's bank is determined to meet Jed Clampett, the bank's financial wizard.

The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.
Brent finds a creative way to get through a week of no TV with the help of Hank and Wanda.

Mr. Chin asks Mr. Kim to be his wingman; Janet asks Jung to fix a leaky pipe, but an intruder interrupts the repair.

El reto consiste en cocinar con lo básico, al vapor, hervido o escalfado, cada participante debe preparar una proteína y hacer un platillo espectacular. En el servicio de este capítulo servirán sashimi en la mesa.
Los restantes 12 concursantes compiten en un desafío intenso y enfrentan la eliminación.
Llegan Hallie y Christina y marcan el reto: cocinar con cerveza. Cada participante debe crear un platillo con uno o más tipos de cerveza.

Gordon Ramsay les pide nominar a alguien para ser su líder, y para el equipo azul es un proceso rápido, pero para el rojo es un gran problema. El chef Ramsay sorprende a los competidores al pedirles reinterpretar 5 clásicos de comida estadounidense.

Los concursantes tienen el reto de preparar postres para una cena romántica. El equipo ganador se lleva un viaje de lujo a Las Vegas, mientras que los perdedores deben realizar los preparativos para la cena de la próxima "noche de cita".

Los concursantes tratan de demostrar sus conocimientos en una prueba de sabor a ciegas, el equipo ganador disfruta un día de paseo a caballo en las colinas de Hollywood, los perdedores se quedan en la cocina, pelando uvas a mano para la cena.
El chef Ramsay viaja a Chicago para remodelar el Zócalo, un restaurante mexicano que cuenta con un equipo desorganizado y un servicio muy malo.
Gordon intenta ayudar a devolver al éxito a un abandonado restaurante de California. El chef Ramsay causa revuelo cuando sugiere cambiar la decoración fea, el menú y la cocina sucia.

Gordon intenta mejorar los negocios en un elegante restaurante de California que necesita clientela desesperadamente. El chef ejecutivo tiene un enfrentamiento con Gordon frente a todo el equipo de trabajo.
Sebastian's prepara comida congelada de un menú complejo, pero los meseros están más preocupados por las audiciones para sus papeles de actuación que por servir las comidas.

Gordon visita un restaurante de Westhampton, Nueva York, en donde el chef principal, el hijo del dueño, hace infelices a todos. Gordon hace cambios drásticos que podrían afectar para siempre a la familia.
El chef Ramsay debe hacer muchos cambios a un pequeño restaurante en Bellmore, Nueva York. The Mixing Bowl enfrenta una afluencia de competencia y apenas tiene clientes.
Los equipos sirven un Quinceañero; un desacuerdo entre chefs trae un estanque en la cena; Ramsay toma una decisión inesperada.
Los cocineros compiten entre ellos para participar en una sesión fotográfica y ser los anfitriones de una cena para los miembros del Ejército.

Carter receives a collect call from Vinnie, and a dark event from the past threatens to destroy his current success. Once a good friend of Carter's, Vinnie is now a deluded barfly living in a small town in California. He has gotten himself into trouble and calls Carter to bail him out before the truth about their past - their involvement in a horse racing scam which resulted in the ruin of an innocent man - comes to light.
John Watkins, Canada's ambassador to Moscow, is suspected of being a communist spy. Based on a true story.
An old adversary of Frost's (David Jason) becomes a suspect in an attempted armed robbery of a brewery. With Philip Jackson, Paul Brightwell and Peter Egan.
Frost goes too far interrogating a drug dealer, then a discovery in the trunk of a stolen car changes the probe's direction.
A disrespected but decent British detective unravels a cold case about a missing seventeen-year-old girl while trying to deal with the breakup of his marriage.

Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.
Four friends travel into the Australian Outback to see Charlie's Farm, the site where a family met a gruesome end.
Members (Charisma Carpenter, Corin Nemec) of a reality TV show investigate a supposedly haunted house.

A writer and his secret lover spend time at a remote cabin in the Appalachian Mountains to work on a horror novel. They learn several boys have gone missing, and after the writer's lover also disappears, he tries to solve the mystery.
(1959) A busboy is embraced by the beatnik art community when he develops an impressive but morbid method of sculpturing. With Dick Miller, Barboura Morris, Anthony Carbone.
A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.
Un hombre contrata a Sídney para encontrar la pistola adornada con diamantes de Al Capone, con la esperanza de limpiar el nombre de su abuelo.
Sídney y Nigel buscan la mitad desaparecida de un par de anillos que garantizan la felicidad para siempre.

La señora Tishell ya no puede ocultar su amor por Martín y, en medio del efecto de las drogas, toma medidas drásticas.
En Soho, Tennison lidera el equipo que investiga la muerte de un joven gigoló.
Una investigación toma un giro complicado cuando comienzan a faltar testigos. Además, Tennison necesita tomar una decisión personal que cambiará su vida.

Nick tries to determine if the spirits of two infamous killers are responsible for haunting an abandoned jail.

Jesse Con-ui's loyalty to the New Mexican Mafia drove him to betray and murder his former mentor.

After he accidentally destroys the winter food supply of his fellow Liberty Park residents, Surly (Will Arnett), a squirrel, is banished to the streets of Oakton. Luckily, Surly finds the town's nut shop and hatches a plan to plunder its bounty. However, unbeknown to Surly and his ragtag team of animal associates, the nut shop is really a front for mobsters who plan to rob the bank next door. While Surly and his team break in to the shop, the mobsters carry out their own scheme.

Before the United States enters World War I, some American youths volunteer for the French military. Subsequently, they become the first U.S. fighter pilots and form a squadron known as the Lafayette Escadrille, whose exploits and heroism become the stuff of legend.

Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.
On a train trip, the Harts investigate an undercover police officer's death; guest Carol Lynley.

The numbers king of the neighborhood commissions J.J. to paint a portrait.

When an old girlfriend visits J.J., she brings along some upsetting news.
Fed up with being treated like a servant by her family, Florida accepts a luncheon invitation from a man.

Junk dealer Fred Sanford runs roughshod over his son and partner, Lamont, in a groundbreaking sitcom. Fred's moneymaking schemes routinely backfire, and he does just about anything to get out of working -- up to and including faking a heart attack. He's rude, sarcastic, outspoken, overtly prejudiced, and pretty darn nasty to his friends and family.
The death of a neighborhood vigilante helps Hunter track down the escaped murderer; McCall works to bust the leader of a high-school pornography film operation.
Hunter and McCall suspect an accused murderer has been framed by psychiatrists who administered psychosis-inducing drugs.

Jim Rockford is an ex-con and private detective. He was falsely convicted of a crime he didn't commit, but that doesn't stop him from using his ex-con buddies to help him solve crimes. Nothing comes easy for Rockford, but he works hard and usually gets shot at or beat up at least once per episode.

The Aluetian Islands are some of the most remote places in the world to hunt; they host the mighty reindeer, the largest antler-to-body animal in North America.
Two guys answer some of the toughest questions in some tense moments.

Unassuming people enter a taxi cab as simple passengers taking a normal ride, only to be shocked when they discover that they're instant contestants. The host, Adam Grove, asks the passengers trivia questions as he escorts them to their destination.
Ryan, Jeff and Matthew are not really sure about the Cash Cab, but once Adam explains the game they are pretty pumped.
Unsuspecting members of the public climbing into an apparently normal taxicab, only to find themselves on national television, with a chance to win a small fortune; hosted by Adam Growe.

A perfectly preserved remedy strategically doctored to sell; popular superheroes stripped down to their humble beginnings; a long-retired but still familiar uniform.
Cees listens to air sirens that served various roles over time; Sandy looks at a red leather fringe jacket; Rebecca looks at a piece of the French Cargo ship.
An illuminating duo puts a spotlight on art deco style; delivering the goods on an iconic Canadian retailer; an antique system designed to capture audio now captures attention.
Italian ingenuity strikes a chord with old Hollywood; hair-raising jewelry keeps deceased loved ones close; a classic design survives a crash with competition.

Brigid looks at a Japanese exclusive edition of a Midge doll; Cees looks at a Picturesque America book that illustrates scenery that changed the perception of the country; Rebecca looks at a Dudson ceramic pitcher from a ceramics hub.
A look at some older finds.
A common thread between a North American college and a Japanese garment; making waves in Chicago following a Halifax tragedy; the Maritimes steer towards a new era of transportation.

One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

It is spring at Kew and after a long, dark winter, nature is coming back to life. Raymond makes his sublime version of rhubarb and custard and Kate finds out how a 12-year-old slave enabled vanilla to become the world's most popular flavour.

Summer has arrived at Kew and everything in Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble's garden is blooming. Butterflies and bees abound and there are new crops to tend, harvest and cook with. Everyone loves a carrot, particularly the carrot fly, so Raymond must protect his crop to ensure he has a good supply for his summer carrot stew.

It's autumn at Kew and the vegetable garden is set to produce a bumper harvest. Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble grow some autumnal favourites and cook them up. Kate finds out why the tomato was once considered to be a deadly poison.

The end of the year at Kew is fast approaching, winter is setting in, but some crops positively love the cold and Raymond learns how brassicas cope in this frosty season. Kate visits Kew's Millennium Seed Bank.

In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.
Presenting from York Gate in Leeds, Adam Frost, Rachel de Thame and Frances Tophill celebrate a garden for all seasons and tackle a bunch of seasonal jobs for September.

A catch-up with three sisters in Dorset to discover how their collapsed greenhouse turned into an opportunity to transform part of their garden. Plus, Monty plants garlic and onions, transplants foxgloves, and prepares his strawberry bed for winter.

Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WWII. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind.

Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.

This documentary programme uses archival footage, interviews and dramatic reconstructions to tell the story of the rise of the Nazis through time as well as the continued rise of Neo-Nazis. `The Rise of the Nazi Party' reveals how the National Socialists exploited economic turmoil to get into power in Germany in 1933 before leading the nation into an era of genocide and military defeat. It profiles the people who helped the Nazis bring destruction to Europe, including Hitler, Himmler and Goebbels.
As punishment for the 1923 'Putsch', Hitler is banned from public speaking. Now he employs Joseph Goebbels to feed Hitler's political ideology to the masses.
Hitler seizes his chance in the wake of The Great Depression, turning the people on the incumbent Democratic Weimar Government and promising a brighter future.
A month after coming to power, Hitler addresses his people through the radio. He promises to make the economy his priority - and the task ahead is massive.
Hitler summons Germany's military leaders to a shock meeting at his headquarters. He lays out his plans for military expansion into neighbouring territories.
Investigate Hitler's biggest mistake, and explore how the German people begin to see through the facade of the Nazi propaganda machine.
Explore how Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party groomed the German people into thinking the genocide of Jewish people was a morally correct decision.
Explore how with Nazi Germany on the back foot, Hitler's attempts to cling to power become ever more desperate, leading to ever more deplorable consequences.
Explore how the Allies final advance on Nazi Germany in January 1945 sounded the death knell for the Third Reich, a regime which continued with its lies to the very end.

Headstrong Thomas Dunson (John Wayne) starts a thriving Texas cattle ranch with the help of his faithful trail hand, Groot (Walter Brennan), and his protégé, Matt Garth (Montgomery Clift), an orphan Dunson took under his wing when Matt was a boy. In need of money following the Civil War, Dunson and Matt lead a cattle drive to Missouri, where they will get a better price than locally, but the crotchety older man and his willful young partner begin to butt heads on the exhausting journey.

When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

In the quiet frontier town of Bitters, Wyo., a dispute between cattleman Blaise Starrett and farmer Hal Crane is about to boil over into a bloody feud. But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation.

Melody Jones (Gary Cooper) is a laid-back cowboy who gets lost on the trail and ends up in the small town of Payneville. Seeing the initials "MJ" on his saddle, the people of Payneville mistake Jones for the treacherous bandit Monte Jarrad (Dan Duryea), and they nearly kill him before he is rescued by Cherry de Longpre (Loretta Young). Grateful for her help, Jones falls for Cherry, not knowing that she is Jarrad's girl and that she plans on using him to help Jarrad elude capture.

Ex-outlaw Link Jones (Gary Cooper) is aboard a train when it is robbed by bandits. When he tries to intervene, he's knocked out and left in the middle of nowhere with saloon singer Billie (Julie London), whom he hoped to hire as a schoolteacher in his town, and Sam (Arthur O'Connell), a con man. Link brings the three to his nearby former home, now the hideout for the bandits, who are led by his uncle (Lee J. Cobb) -- and to save his new friends, he must rejoin the old gang for one last holdup.

Following the American Civil War, veteran Benjamin Trane (Gary Cooper) and gunslinger Joe Erin (Burt Lancaster) are just two of many men who head to Mexico as mercenaries. When Emperor Maximilian (George Macready) recruits their services, they reluctantly work together, since the price is right. Trane and Erin are to escort Countess Marie Duvarre (Denise Darcel) to Veracruz -- but when they find a wealth of gold hidden in the stagecoach, the original plan no longer applies.

By 1885, beloved cavalryman Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) has hired a publicist and producer to help shape and promote his traveling Wild West show, which presents historically inaccurate reenactments of conflicts between U.S. troops and Native Americans. Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull.

Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los pitufos, ya que canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto.
Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de resolver un acertijo druídico.
Los Pitufos se encontrarán con Simón, quien perdió el rumbo mientras intentaba hallar a sus padres, y lo ayudarán a regresar a su casa. Gargamel intentará complicar sus planes.

Un día, un cachorro llega inesperadamente a la aldea de los pitufos. El cachorro causa sensación, en especial un medallón que cuelga de su cuello y que indica que no debe abrirse. Papá Pitufo decide regresar el perro al Gran Mago.

Poeta y Pintor dejan la aldea de los Pitufos, sin saber que Gargamel tiene planes de atraparlos.
Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás. Va a curarles todos sus males.
Un duende maligno le da a Pitufina zapatos de baile y luego la engaña para lograr que ella prometa casarse con él.

Los Pitufos malinterpretaron la orden de Papá Pitufo de dedicar un día laborable a los Pequeños Pitufos. En lugar de tomarse el día libre, trabajaron más duro que nunca y contrajeron la Enfermedad del Trabajo.
El Pitufo Volador no puede decidir nada, por lo que los demás pitufos lo llevan al bosque para una prueba de supervivencia, donde solo podrá encontrar el camino a casa tomando decisiones.

Rick encuentra una granja en la que buscar ayuda para salvar la vida de su hijo, quien recibió el impacto accidental de una bala. Después, Shane entra en una escuela llena de zombis para llevarse material sanitario junto al tipo que disparó a Carl.

Shane y Otis están atrapados por los zombis en la escuela adonde acudieron por el material sanitario necesario para operar a Carl. En la granja, surgen las primeras tensiones y Daryl y Andrea vuelven a salir en busca de Sophie.

Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que ha tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

Mientras busca a Sophia, Daryl sufre un accidente que lo deja perdido y herido en el bosque. La tensión entre el grupo y los propietarios de la granja aumenta, así como la inestabilidad del propio grupo, debido a que Shane desafía a Rick.

Tras descubrir que la familia mantiene encerrada a sus familiares convertidos en zombis en el granero, Dale confronta a Hershel. Lori, por su parte, confiesa a Rick que está embarazada y los problemas entre los integrantes del grupo se intensifican.

Glenn le revela a todo el grupo el secreto del granero, pero no están de acuerdo sobre cómo actuar: Rick ordena respetar la autoridad de Hershel, aunque Shane quiere acabar con los zombis. Por otra parte, descubren por fin qué le ha pasado a Sophia.

Hershel no soporta lo ocurrido y recae en su alcoholismo, pero Rick y Glenn lo siguen hasta la ciudad para evitar que muera. Entretanto, Beth, incapaz de aceptar todo lo que le está sucediendo a su familia, entra en estado catatónico.

Lori sale en busca de Rick, pero lo único que encuentra es un peligro mortal y Shane va tras ella. Entretanto, Rick, Hershel y Glenn mantienen un tiroteo con los desconocidos con quienes cruzaron sus caminos en el bar.

La tensión entre Rick y Shane aumenta y la decisión sobre el destino de Randall es el detonante: Shane quiere matarlo, Rick prefiere dejarlo vivo. Mientras, Beth pretende suicidarse y Andrea, quien debe vigilarla, no cumple con su cometido.

In occupied Germany in 1949, American military officer Jefferson Pike (James Garner) wakes up in a U.S. Army hospital with no memory of the previous five years. A kindly military psychiatrist (Rod Taylor) and his coolly detached nurse (Eva Marie Saint) draw out Pike's last clear memories, which are of General Eisenhower's final briefing for the Normandy invasion in June 1944. Soon, Pike realizes that his doctor and nurse are not who they claim to be, and that he is in great danger.
